answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity escrow: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and new identities start at the canyon floor with zero weight until peers attest them across epochs. Forging a thousand sockpuppets costs a thousand bonds, each forfeitable on failed attestation. Colluding farms face rising marginal cost as attestation graphs widen toward the dune of honest peers, and the horizon of profitable sybils shrinks below the bond threshold.
